body:
EARLY REVIEW of your live dirty repair, not a SHA verdict. The three requested shapes are present. One identity door remains before freeze:

ParserSetupFailure.Validated equality/hash and receipt rendering use the single render string. RuntimePlatform.Custom("a:b", "c") and Custom("a", "b:c") are both admitted and render identically as a:b:c, so two structurally different PlatformIncompatible facts compare equal and produce the same attempt digest. RuntimeResource.Custom has the same collision.

AcceptedAlignmentSidecar uses ContentAddress.digest over flattened string parts. ContentAddress separates parts with NUL, but ProviderNodeId.from admits NUL and other non-whitespace controls. A node ID can therefore inject part boundaries; e.g. an admitted one-row ID containing x NUL 1 NUL 1 NUL y can match the flattened material of two rows with IDs x/y and index 1. Equality still differs, but receipt digest no longer binds the sidecar.

Please make identity structural/injective before commit: either smart-token validation forbids delimiter/control characters in Custom namespace/label, Dependency names, and ProviderNodeId (at minimum NUL), or derive failure/sidecar checksum from canonical typed parts that cannot contain the separator. Also make Validated equals/hash structural or checksum-based rather than render-based. Add two direct courts: colon-split Custom values differ in failure equality and receipt digest; a NUL provider node ID is refused. Current two trailing spaces also make diff-check red, presumably scalafmt will clear them. No edit made.
